description: For one commodity and year, compare countries as a source: what the grower was paid (FAOSTAT farm gate) against what it left the country for (UN Comtrade export unit value), plus the share reaching the grower. Ranked cheapest first on a named observable field — there is NO opportunity score, because the weights would be invented. Supply freight_usd / duty_rate_pct to add a landed cost; absent costs are never defaulted, they are listed in `missing`. Annual data: this supports structural comparison, not an arbitrage claim. Covers the seven crops FAOSTAT prices.

commodity.description: Instrument code. Example: CC for cocoa.

currency.description: Optional ISO currency for an additional converted view.

year.description: Four-digit year; defaults to the latest available.

name: sourcing.compare

available.description: False when fewer than two countries could be compared. Served free in that case.

countries.description: Cheapest first on the ranked field

far_from_peers.description: Outside the peer band either way. Worth a look, not a verdict.

farm_share_pct.description: Farm gate over export unit value. A supply-chain signal, not a margin anyone earned.

reason.description: Why a row is incomplete, when it is

missing.description: Cost fields not supplied, hence excluded

notes.description: Read before presenting any figure from this tool.

ranked_by.description: The observable field the list is sorted by

unavailable.description: Sources that could not contribute, each with the reason

title: Compare Sourcing Countries
